items.detail: Outline allowed, 1 sheet front and back, bullets only, no AI

posts.text: Clarification on Individual Reflection Requirements. The individual reflection does not need to be a 4-5 paragraph essay. 2 well-developed paragraphs are enough for full credit. Address the components in Part III: Individual Reflection. Each group member writes their own. Submit it at the end of your group's presentation or as a Word document on Schoology. If you did not complete only this part, you may submit by 11:59 PM October 23 without losing points.

Reminders: You are allowed to have your outline for your exam. Outline format: one 8.5x11 sheet, front and back, handwritten or typed (12 font), bullet points not paragraphs, AI usage is not allowed. Ms. Browne will examine all outlines before the exam and may not allow them based on content and structure.
